Received Empty Chromebook Box

Hello, I am reaching out to report a consumer issue involving Walmart that I believe raises concerns about fulfillment practices and customer resolution policies especially during the holiday season. On 12/16/2025, I ordered a Chromebook from Walmart online that was advertised at a sale price with limited stock. The item arrived two days later, but when I opened the package, the Chromebook box was completely empty. There was no device inside. I immediately contacted Walmart customer service and escalated the issue to a supervisor. I explained that this appeared to be a fulfillment failure or loss issue, not a standard return, and requested a replacement at the original sale price, or an equivalent solution since the item was limited stock and time-sensitive for Christmas. I have not received a refund nor confirmation of email correspondence stating that I will get a refund or stating that I have had conversations pertaining to this topic.

Helpful?1WU5T4S5PQU75113175776
reply from TeamAcer

Dear Kendra, We are sorry to hear you are having trouble with your Walmart order. With most retail locations it can take up to 30 days to receive a refund. We suggest you check again with Walmart to see when you can expect the refund, as they will be best able to help you with your order. We appreciate you taking the time to write this review. Regards, Acer America
